verdict.rationale: HubSpot docs confirm you can connect an individual work email (Gmail/Outlook) to log email replies to the CRM and send emails from the CRM, which supports the core email-sync/logging use case (hubspot-docs-13/21/46). However, the evidence never explicitly describes two-way sync mechanics or how HubSpot matches/logs emails to the 'right' contact/company record automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of two-way sync behavior, automatic record-matching logic, and independent/hands-on confirmation that logging works reliably in practice.
